subject: MATH150
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos covering the specified discrete mathematics topics. The selections prioritize high relevance, educational quality, and strong view counts to ensure peer-validated content. For topics with few direct candidates, videos covering the necessary prerequisite methods (like Boolean matrix multiplication for relation powers) were chosen. All hard gates and constraints were followed.

coverage.note: Several candidates were about logical equivalence, not equivalence relations, and were eliminated for low relevance.
Many candidates were about 'partial derivatives' and were correctly ignored. Selected the video that explicitly mentions Hasse diagrams to best address the student's visualization problem.
One high-view candidate was rejected due to an admitted error in the explanation.
Several candidates were about function composition, not relation composition, and were eliminated for low relevance.
Few direct candidates were available; selected a highly-viewed, comprehensive video on matrices in discrete math that covers the required Boolean product method.

videos.title: 2.13 Equivalence Classes and Partition in Discrete Maths
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed video provides a clear and comprehensive explanation of both equivalence classes and partitions, directly addressing the core concepts.

videos.title: Partial Order Relation | POSET in Discrete Mathematics
videos.filter_reason: With exceptional view count, this video offers a concise yet thorough introduction to partial order relations and POSETs, making it an excellent starting point.

videos.title: Discrete Math 9.1.2 Properties of Relations
videos.filter_reason: This video's focus on comparing all relation properties is ideal for clearing up confusion between symmetric, antisymmetric, and transitive relations.

videos.title: Composition of Relations
videos.filter_reason: From a trusted channel, this popular and concise video clearly explains the concept and process of composing relations with good examples.

videos.title: Boolean Matrix Multiplication: Easy to Follow Example!
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a very clear and easy-to-follow example of Boolean matrix multiplication, directly addressing the computational method students struggle with for this topic.
